item.title: Winter on Mackinac Island: Meet the cookie shop owner showing off winter on the Great Lakes
item.description: When Kate Conlon was little, she told her grandmother she was going to teach third grade and live on Mackinac Island. She has since found residence on Michigan's most iconic island, but instead of teaching, she runs a cookie shop. Armed with her mother's recipes, the help of her sister, and an eye for the best sights and sounds of Mackinac, Conlon has been sharing snippets of her life from a fast-growing presence on Instagram."It feels like it's out of a Disney movie," she said. item.title: Lake Erie Ice Fracture: Time-lapse shows 80-mile crack form across lake
item.description: Ice on the Great Lakes has made a show of itself this winter; just ask the region's research lab that tracks its ice coverage. item.title: 'Absolutely NOTHING!' President Trump threatens to block opening of Gordie Howe bridge
item.description: A bridge in Detroit between the US and Canada that was expected to open this year is now being threatened by President Donald Trump. item.title: 'Strength and perseverance:' Former Detroit Lion Tracy Scroggins dies at the age of 56
item.description: Former Detroit Lions player Tracy Scroggins has died at the age of 56.The Lions announced on social media on Monday that Tracy Scroggins, who played for Detroit from 1992 to 2001, had died. The former linebacker's family sent a statement to TMZ regarding his death, revealing that he had suffered from chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) after retiring from the NFL.
